author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN009167560 (PTHR43157)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel PIG-F and orthologs

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous source

PTN009167560 is annotated with the MF 'mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity' based on one source annotation to YEAST\|SGD=S000002710\|UniProtKB=Q06636) (aka GPI11) from PMID: 10793139 by SGD.

This annotation is then propagated to GPI11/PIGF orthologs.

However this protein is a non-catalytic component of the complex catalysing that reaction.
As the abstract of PMID: 10793139 says:
"Because Gpi11p and Pig-Fp affect EthN-P transfer to Man-2 and Man-3, respectively, these proteins may act in partnership with the GPI-EthN-P transferases"

So, 'mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity' should be removed from this PAINT node.
title: PAINT issue: PTN009167560 (PTHR43157)

author: marcfeuermann
body: Indeed another case of non-catalytic sub-unit wrong annotation. Removed
